title: Original Double Gauss

collection.source: lens-designs.com, Dan Reiley's collection of optical designs in Zemax format
collection.source_basis: The .zmx file is the direct source for the surface table: radii, thicknesses, glasses, clear semi-diameters, conic constants and aspheric terms are read from it. The collection's summary sheet, where it lists this input, is the independent check of the first-order values.
collection.source_revision: site snapshot read on 2026-11-27; the collection states no version of its own
collection.attribution: Prescription from lens-designs.com (photographic-primes), file US00583336-2-scaled.zmx. The collection states that every file carries the MIT licence unless its own Notes section says otherwise; this file carries no Notes section.
collection.contributor: Prepared for the lens-designs collection through JunLin615
collection.redistribution: The collection states the MIT licence for its files (note-on-ip page) and that the designs themselves are public domain, being transcriptions of patent or journal publications. The notice is committed at licenses/LensDesigns-MIT.txt.

aperture_validity.basis: The file marks this surface as the stop and its clear semi-diameter is the smallest of the system, so the plate limits the beam.
aperture_validity.consequence: The Project is eligible for stop-dependent evaluation, but no pupil sample or illumination result is recorded, so no stop-dependent match is claimed.
aperture_validity.satisfaction_basis: No pupil sample or illumination measurement is recorded.

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: DERIVED: the file's WAVM lines are air wavelengths at the reference environment; each is converted once to vacuum with the engine's own air model
spectrum.wavelength_precision: Vacuum nanometres, full precision, as the engine evaluates them.

continuous_coverage_nm.note: The file states its sampling wavelengths only; it states no operating band.

back_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial distance from the final surface vertex to the rear focal point

total_track_mm.definition: First surface vertex to the image plane along the axis

engine_check.method: Thick-lens ABCD through the committed Project at the primary wavelength

f_number.definition: Image-space f-number, from the file's FNUM line with type flag 0

stop_opening_diameter_mm.definition: Diameter of the aperture stop's clear opening as the file states it

field.definition: Field angles, from the file's FTYP and YFLN lines

materials.policy: Glasses the file names are taken from the published catalog when the engine resolves the name; a name it does not resolve, and a ___BLANK glass, are modelled from the nd and vd the file states, as recorded here.

catalog_comparisons.basis: PROJECT_DECLARED: the file's nd and vd are this catalog glass, so the catalog record and its dispersion curve are used
PROJECT_DECLARED: the file's nd and vd are this catalog glass, so the catalog record and its dispersion curve are used

evidence_notes: The file states 12 surfaces in 4 elements and 1 aperture stop(s); the import reproduces that decomposition.
The image plane is placed at 61.881700 mm from the first surface vertex, the sum of the transcribed thicknesses.

record_hash_method: SHA-256 over this record's JSON with the record_hash and record_hash_method members removed: json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8, no trailing newline
